## Checks

- [ ] `make check` passes on my computer (lint, examples, format, build and browser tests)
- [ ] I looked at screenshots of the pages I changed (375 and 1280 px wide in light and dark mode, plus 320 px for pages with tabs, tables or diagrams) and walked the visual checklist in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] My commits follow Conventional Commits, such as `docs(ch00): add lesson 0.14`
- [ ] I did not commit `.venv/`, `site/`, screenshots, caches or secrets

## Content checklist

Skip this part for changes that do not touch lessons.

- [ ] **C1** The wording is original: nothing is copied or closely paraphrased
- [ ] **C2** Every fact that can change (versions, menu names, licensing) was checked against a primary source, and is phrased to age well
- [ ] **C3** The lesson covers what it promises and does not teach later chapters in depth
- [ ] **C4** Every complete program is an included example that the checks build and run
- [ ] **C5** Each term is bolded once where it is defined, and used consistently afterwards
- [ ] **C6** Callouts have the right type and are not stacked or overused
- [ ] **C7** Tabs use exactly the two approved sets of labels
- [ ] **C8** The length is reasonable, and paragraphs have four sentences or fewer
- [ ] **C9** There is a summary, and further reading uses primary sources over https
- [ ] **C10** A beginner could follow every instruction without guessing
